title: Seti I of Egypt's 19th Dynasty
summary: The 19th-Dynasty pharaoh Seti I, father of Rameses II.
description: The 19th-Dynasty pharaoh Seti I, father of Rameses II. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 670 - 611 BC (AP-70, OSF preprint CFAH-9)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-9: The 19th and 26th Dynasties of Egypt," OSF preprint v1.4 (25 Sep 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/HV3B2, file CFAH-9_Dynasties_19_and_26_v1.4.pdf, p. 16, section "AP-70: Seti I : 670 - 611 BC"
chronologies.note: Printed with spaced hyphen ("670 - 611 BC"); the anchor point spans Seti I's career as CFAH-9 reconstructs it.
